authorship: Original procedural choreography; not motion capture or reproductions of named routines

clips.name: Neon step-touch
clips.description: Side taps, easy rebound and relaxed arm pulls.

clips.name: Disco diagonals
clips.description: Alternating diagonal reaches with a clean return.

clips.name: Point & pull
clips.description: Forward points answered by compact elbow pulls.

clips.name: Cross-punch bounce
clips.description: Alternating cross-body punches with grounded knee pulses.

clips.name: Shoulder pops
clips.description: Shoulder isolation over gentle side taps.

clips.name: Head-nod pocket
clips.description: Compact groove for verses or backing dancers.

clips.name: Ripple body roll
clips.description: A phased spine-to-chest roll above planted feet.

clips.name: Overhead heart sway
clips.description: A broad overhead heart silhouette, opening to a V.

clips.name: Cheek-frame bounce
clips.description: Face-framing elbows and playful alternating head tilts.

clips.name: Wrist-flick steps
clips.description: Raised elbows and little wrist accents.

clips.name: Swimming sweeps
clips.description: Broad scoops that travel across the front of the body.

clips.name: Chest hit & open
clips.description: Closed hits that expand into strong open shapes.

clips.name: March & pump
clips.description: Alternating knee lifts and opposite-arm pumps.

clips.name: Running-man lite
clips.description: A stylized in-place back-step and knee-lift phrase.

clips.name: Heel switches
clips.description: Alternating forward heel presentations and returns.

clips.name: Side shuffle
clips.description: Small quick foot placements with compact arm accents.

clips.name: Kick & change
clips.description: Small forward kicks followed by a reset under the body.

clips.name: Double bounce V
clips.description: Two grounded rebounds into a big overhead V.

clips.name: Sunburst reaches
clips.description: Large alternating arm arcs with an open chorus silhouette.

clips.name: Tutting boxes
clips.description: Angular elbow shapes with deliberate held accents.

clips.name: Low scoop & rise
clips.description: A shallow grounded scoop rising into an open reach.

clips.name: Power stomp
clips.description: Alternating low stomps under sharply accented arm hits.

clips.name: Turn & present
clips.description: Small left-right torso turns, then a camera-facing presentation.

clips.name: Ending-fairy pose
clips.description: A held face-framing pose, tiny wave and celebratory finish.

clips.name: Galloping superstar
clips.description: An imaginary pony, bouncing reins and a completely unnecessary victory salute.

clips.name: Invisible guitar hero
clips.description: Wide-stance air-guitar strumming, head bobs and a rock-star finish.

clips.name: Robot warranty void
clips.description: Angular locks, a controlled mechanical twitch, then a reboot into a deadpan pose.

clips.name: Chicken-wing champion
clips.description: Flapping elbows, bobbing head and brisk barnyard knee lifts.

clips.name: Shopping-trolley shuffle
clips.description: Push the invisible trolley, grab something off each shelf, celebrate checkout.

clips.name: Sprinkler emergency
clips.description: One folded elbow pumps while the straight arm sweeps; swap sides halfway.

clips.name: Tiny violin, huge drama
clips.description: An invisible violin solo performed with wildly disproportionate emotion.

clips.name: Inflatable tube Claude
clips.description: A soft alternating arm wave with a spine-to-head wobble: inflatable forecourt energy.

clips.name: Crab-rave committee
clips.description: Low sideways scuttles and raised claw-shaped hands, conducted with total seriousness.

clips.name: Penguin power waddle
clips.description: Flipper-like arms, short alternating steps and an overconfident waddling sway.

clips.name: Disco rocket
clips.description: Compress into a crouch, launch a little star hop, land and hit a diagonal.

clips.name: Caffeine overload
clips.description: Fast knees and pumping elbows, as though the encore depends on a double espresso.

clips.name: Sneak, then flex
clips.description: Suspicious tiptoe-like knee lifts interrupted by extravagant double-biceps poses.

clips.name: Diva hair-flip
clips.description: A theatrical head toss and one-arm flourish, even with absolutely no hair.

clips.name: Windmill hype
clips.description: Broad alternating arm circles with a side-to-side rebound.

clips.name: Victory boxer
clips.description: A bouncy guard, playful air jabs and a raised-arm winner pose.

clips.name: Zombie disco
clips.description: Straight reaching arms, lurching knees and a brief return to disco consciousness.

clips.name: Knees-up kick line
clips.description: Alternating high-knee kicks under wide arms; designed for a synchronized chorus line.

clips.name: Sassy elbow shuffle
clips.description: Elbow leads, loose side-to-side arm swings and a counter-swinging hip groove.

clips.name: Invisible mic drop
clips.description: Mime an enormous vocal note, release the imaginary mic, bow and accept the applause.

clips.name: Panic, then pose
clips.description: Frantic upper-body flutters turn into utterly composed model poses.

clips.name: Low-bounce boss
clips.description: Grounded wide-knee rebounds, strong cross-body hits and big chorus silhouettes.

clips.name: Moonwalk-ish mischief
clips.description: A deliberately stylized in-place heel-slide illusion with a cheeky camera point.

clips.name: Finale fireworks
clips.description: Sky punches, an open-arm hop, a large V and an exaggerated thank-you bow.
